help.faq.journal-private-photos.question: Nshobora kubika amafoto y'ibanga?
help.faq.journal-private-photos.subtitle: Kugira ukurikirane impinduka zimwezimwe zigaragara.
help.faq.journal-private-photos.answer: Ego. Amafoto y'ibanga arinzwe araboneka, nk'akarorero kugira ukurikirane ukuntu ibiheri, imisatsi ikura canke ibimenyetso vyo ku ruhu bihinduka.
help.faq.security-private-data.question: AWA irinda gute amakuru yanje?
help.faq.security-private-data.subtitle: Ibanga, umutekano no gufata amakuru make.
help.faq.security-private-data.answer: AWA yubatswe ku gufata amakuru make gushoboka, nta matangazo ayerekeza ku muntu, nta kugurisha amakuru bwite, no kuyabika mu mutekano hamwe n'ugufunga nyakuri (encryption) kw'amakuru y'ibanga.
help.faq.security-export.question: Nshobora kwohereza amakuru yanje hanze?
help.faq.security-export.subtitle: PDF na CSV birashoboka.
help.faq.security-export.answer: Ego. Hariho export ya PDF y'ibikurikirane vyawe na export ya CSV y'amakuru yawe, kugira ubone amateka asobanutse, harimwo no kugira ubigeze ku muganga.
help.faq.security-delete.question: Nshobora gusiba amakuru yanje vyoroshe?
help.faq.security-delete.subtitle: Gusiba biguma vyoroshe kandi biraboneka.
help.faq.security-delete.answer: Ego. Gusiba byoroshejwe amakuru yawe na konti yawe biraboneka mu miburiburi ibijanye.
help.guides.getting-started.title: Gutangura gukoresha AWA
help.guides.getting-started.text: Menya urupapuro rwawe rw'intango, kalendari, ikayi, intumbero n'ibimenyetso vy'iyobokamana.
help.guides.cycle.title: Gukurikirana uruziga
help.guides.cycle.text: Andika imihango yawe, ingene amaraso ari menshi, kandi urabe ibigereranyo vy'uruziga rwawe.
help.guides.conceive.title: Gushaka inda
help.guides.conceive.text: Kurikirana uburumbuke, ovulation, ubushuhe bw'umubiri bw'ibanze, ibisohoka mu nkondo y'inda n'ibizamini bya LH.
help.guides.contraception.title: Kuboneza urubyaro
help.guides.contraception.text: Tunganya uburyo bwawe, ibibutsa, ibinini vyibagiranye n'amateka y'ukunywa.
help.guides.irregular.title: Uruziga rudahoraho / PCOS
help.guides.irregular.text: Raba uruziga rudahoraho, ibiheri, imisatsi ikura, uburemere n'ibimenyetso bijanye.
help.guides.menopause.title: Perimenopause / Menopause
help.guides.menopause.text: Kurikirana ubushuhe butunguranye (hot flashes), ibitotsi, umunaniro, umutima n'imiti ya hormone.
help.guides.pregnancy.title: Gukurikirana inda
help.guides.pregnancy.text: Kurikirana itariki yo kubyara, amaceweru, ibihe vyo kubonana n'abaganga, ibizamini n'ibimenyetso.
help.guides.postpartum.title: Inyuma yo kubyara
help.guides.postpartum.text: Kurikirana lochia, isubira ry'uruziga, konsa, ibitotsi, umutima no gukira.
help.guides.loss.title: Inyuma yo gukoroka inda
help.guides.loss.text: Kurikirana amaraso, ibimenyetso n'isubira ry'uruziga rwawe ku muvuduko wawe.
help.guides.calendar.title: Gukoresha kalendari
help.guides.calendar.text: Sobanukirwa imihango, ibigereranyo, ibimenyetso n'ukwerekana kwa Gregorian / Hijri.
help.guides.journal.title: Kuzuza ikayi yawe ya buri munsi
help.guides.journal.text: Andika ibimenyetso, umutima, ibitotsi, ibikorwa, inyandiko n'ubuhisho.
help.guides.spiritual.title: Gukoresha ibimenyetso vy'iyobokamana
help.guides.spiritual.text: Menya kalendari ya Hijri, ugusukura, salat, sawm, qada na nifas.
help.guides.privacy.title: Ibanga n'amakuru
help.guides.privacy.text: Tunganya umutekano, uburyo bw'ibanga, export, encryption no gusiba amakuru.
help.helpSupport.title: Ubufasha n'inkunga
help.helpSupport.subtitle: Ufise ikibazo? Turi hano ngo tugufashe.
help.helpSupport.supportText: Hitamwo uburyo bwo kutwandikira bukubereye, canke urabe ibisubizo bikunze kuboneka.
help.helpSupport.guidesSubtitle: Menya ibitabu vyacu bifasha kugira ukoreshe AWA neza.
help.helpSupport.feedbackSubtitle: Dusangize ibitekerezo vyawe kugira dutezimbere iyi porogarama.
help.helpSupport.bugReportSubtitle: Menyesha ikosa canke ikintu kitari citezwe.
help.helpSupport.bannerText: Urakoze kuba wafashe umwanya wo kutwandikira.
help.helpSupport.modal.errorEmpty: Sobanura ivyo usavye imbere yo gukomeza.
help.faqScreen.title: Ibibazo bikunze kubazwa
help.faqScreen.intro: Shira ku bisubizo vy'ingenzi kugira ukoreshe AWA utuje.
help.guidesScreen.title: Ibitabu bifasha n'inyigisho
help.guidesScreen.intro: Inama zoroshe zo kugufasha gukoresha AWA neza.
help.whatsNewScreen.title: Ibishasha
help.whatsNewScreen.heading: AWA irakomeza gutera imbere
help.whatsNewScreen.body: Nta nkuru z'ivyahinduwe zemewe zirashirwaho. Ivyongerewe bizoza bizoboneka hano nibimara gutangazwa.

Impamvu uruziga rufata igihe co gutuza, n'igihe co kubona muganga.

library.articles.ovulation-comprendre-ov: Akanya k'ingenzi k'uruziga rwawe, n'ingene wakamenya.
library.articles.pain-gerer-douleurs.sum: Ubushuhe, kugenda buhoro, ifunguro: ingeso zifasha koko.
library.articles.hydration-bien-shydrate: Kunywa amazi ahagije mu ruziga rwose
Impamvu kunywa amazi menshi bigabanya kubyimba inda imbere y'imihango.
Impamvu ibitotsi vyawe bihinduka hakurikijwe igice c'uruziga, no mu gihe ca menopause.
library.articles.mood-humeur-et-hormones: Impamvu umutima wawe uhinduka mu ruziga rwose no mu buzima bwose.
library.articles.basaltemp-suivre-temper: Uburyo bworoshe bwo kwemeza ko ovulation yabaye.
library.articles.cervicalmucus-observer-: Ikimenyetso kuri ubuntu, kamere, cogufasha kumenya iminsi yawe y'uburumbuke.
library.articles.lhtests-comprendre-test: Ingene ivyo bizamini bikora n'igihe co kubikoresha.
library.articles.nutrition-conception-fe: Intungamubiri zifasha uruziga rw'uburumbuke n'inda nzima.
library.articles.conceptiontips-essayer-: Ibimenyetso vy'ingenzi vyo gutangura urugendo rwawe rwo gushaka inda utuje.

library.articles.sideeffects-reconnaitre: Ivyo bisanzwe kandi bitagira ingaruka, n'ivyo bikwiye kwitwararikwa.
library.articles.pcos-comprendre-sopk.su: Polycystic ovary syndrome, isobanuwe neza: ico ari co, ukuntu itandukana ku mugore umwe n'uwundi, n'aho wokwiga vyinshi.
library.articles.pcos-cycle-ovulation-fe: Uruziga, ovulation n'uburumbuke mu gihe ufise PCOS

library.articles.pcos-diagnostic-examens: Ingene PCOS imenyekana, n'ingene wokwitegura igihe cawe co kubonana na muganga.
library.articles.pcos-poids-metabolisme-: Isano hagati ya PCOS, uburemere na insulin resistance, nta gucira urubanza canke inzira z'ubusamo.
library.articles.pcos-mode-de-vie-prise-: Uburyo bwo gutunganya PCOS, n'ingeso zoroshe zifasha ubuzima bwawe bwa buri munsi.
library.articles.pcos-acne-hormonale.sum: Impamvu ibiheri vya hormone bishobora kuboneka igihe ufise PCOS, ingene wobimenya, n'ibisubizo bishobora gufasha kubitunganya.
library.articles.hormones-menopause-equi: Estrogen, progesterone, FSH, LH: ingene zihinduka n'impamvu ibimenyetso bitandukana.

library.articles.pregnancy-semaine-par-s: Ingendo z'ingenzi kuva ku gihe ca mbere gushika ku gihe ca gatatu (trimester).
library.articles.babydevelopment-develop: Ingene umwana wawe akura, igihe ku gihe (trimester).

library.articles.treatments-traitements-: Imiti ya hormone n'ubundi buryo butari ubwa hormone, mu ncamake.
Incamake yuzuye y'ingingo nkuru za fiqh y'abagore, hagati y'ibikorwa vy'iyobokamana n'ubuzima bwa buri munsi.
library.articles.menstruationpurity-stat: Uko ugusukura (purity) kwo mu iyobokamana kumeze: iby'ibanze

library.articles.prayerduringmenstruatio: Impamvu salat ihagarikwa muri iki gihe, n'ingene wokibaho utuje.
library.articles.returningtoprayer-le-gh: Intambwe rusange zo gusubira muri salat inyuma y'imihango, utuje.
